name: Dance-Pop-Zoe Girl A web asset pack (test, Way A)

canvas.note: all frames share one canvas (transparent PNG-like WebP). Draw every frame at the same position/size; feet baseline y=753 is identical in all frames (spin/jump included, jump frames lift off naturally). Moonwalk drift is baked in.

idle.note: Frame 1 == neutral. Start a move when idle is at frame index 0 (neutral) - every move begins and ends at neutral.

spin.note: one full turn (front -> back -> front); back-view frames spin-4..7 have no face anchors (facing=back)

moonwalk.note: backward glide is baked into the frames (hold frames drift up to 72 px of the 682x1024 source to the viewer's right, out frames glide back to x=0); keep character x fixed while playing it

maskFiles.rgb: masks/<id>.webp (lossless, opaque): R=hair, G=top/cardigan, B=skirt/bottom (0..255 soft coverage)

recolor.howTo: Draw frame to canvas, read mask pixels (same size), for each pixel with coverage c>0 shift the frame pixel towards the new colour: convert to HSL, set hue to target hue, scale saturation/lightness by target/base (keep line-art: weight = c * (0.35+0.65*smoothstep(L 0.2..0.55))). Mask files must be loaded lossless; never premultiply (masks are opaque).
recolor.notes: Face is protected (eyes/skin are never in the hair mask); white blouse, shoes and gold items are in no mask.

crown.note: sprite centre sits on frame anchor "crown"; width = 2.7 * anchors.ed

earL.note: scale = frame.anchors.ed / refEyeDistance; sprite anchor point sits on the frame anchor

earR.note: scale = frame.anchors.ed / refEyeDistance; sprite anchor point sits on the frame anchor

sunglasses.note: scale = frame.anchors.ed / refEyeDistance; sprite anchor point sits on the frame anchor

pendant.note: scale = frame.anchors.ed / refEyeDistance; sprite anchor point sits on the frame anchor

bow.note: scale = frame.anchors.ed / refEyeDistance; sprite anchor point sits on the frame anchor

anchorsDoc.eyeMid: midpoint between the two eye centres (green iris detection; manual for hairflip-2, spin-2, spin-3)
anchorsDoc.angleDeg: head roll (eye line angle), clockwise positive in screen coords
anchorsDoc.earL: lobe attach point image-left, earR image-right (formula from face frame; verified visually)
anchorsDoc.facing: front | side (turned head, approximate) | back (no face; anchors estimated from silhouette top)
